biggest_catch: The $25 bonus offer explicitly ends 10/31/2026, and the friend must be 18+ in a qualifying new account within 60 days.
catches: Referrer and the referred new member each receive $25 deposited into their Primary Savings for a valid referral.
Bonus offer of $25 deposit ends 10/31/2026; referral program subject to change or discontinuation at any time.
Referrer must be an existing member of the credit union in good standing; employees and officials cannot participate.

Friend must mention your name as the Referrer; new account must include one of the listed qualifying options (e.g., savings with $25/month DD, checking with 5+ debit transactions, money market kept open 45 days, $500 savings balance for 45 consecutive days within 60 days).
Only one bonus per qualifying referred new member; must be 18 or older; new accounts must meet qualifications within 60 days of account opening.

After 5 eligible referrals, the referrer may choose one additional reward (e.g., $40 deposited into the account, skip one loan payment, or loan rate/fee perks); bonuses non-transferrable, valid 12 months from issue.
Tax treatment not stated on the page.
